tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bzhugs so// swa sti/ rab dkar tshogs gnyis pad mtsho las 'khrungs shing / /skyes stobs blo gros rab gsal dang ldan pas/ /rgyal ba'i bsngags pa'i lam brnyes chos kyi rje/ /rdo rje gsum dngos mngon gyur de la 'dud/ /ngan ngon srid pa'i bde la ma chags par/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun dbyi mnga' ba/ /de sogs yongs 'dzin mkhas grub tshogs rnams las/ /zab rgyas theg gsum chos mdzod brnyes la 'dud/ /dben pa'i ri sul ltos med nyams dga' bar/ /lus srog thed la bor ba'i sgrub tshugs kyis/ /rang sems chos sku'i ngo bor mngon gyur nas/ /skal ldan zab mo'i lam la 'god la 'dud/ /khyad par mi min snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs/ /'bangs su bsdus nas dkar po'i lam bkod pa/ /'dir snang byis pas bsam pa'i yul min pa'i/ /grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug khyed la 'dud/ /khyed kyi sgrub gnas thugs dam rten gsum sogs/ /mtshan gzhir byas nas dad pas kun blangs te/ /rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs pa'i gdul bya la/ /sgrib med ye shes gzigs pas da lta skyongs/ /chu bur lta bur mi rtag lus srog 'di/ /nam 'chi nges med dran pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ dka' spyad dam pa'i chos la nus pa yis/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag bde 'dod pa sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhir/ /rtogs nas sgo gsum dge tshogs thams cad kun/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i don du bsngos pa'i mthus/ /sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gdong spras bsam gtan gling gi dgon gnas 'debs mkhan/ grub mchog gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa 'di dgon gnas de nyid kyi 'dus tshogs spyi'i bskul nas dge slong snyoms las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris te dpal e waṃ chos ldan nas phul ba dge bar gyur cig

/shu bhaṃ// ༈ /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mo la bstod pa mngon rtogs rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti bi dza yantu/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar ni/ /mkhyen ldan shes rab lha mo'i skur bstan pa/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can grags pa'i gdugs dkar 'dzin/ /tshangs sras lha mo dwang bas bstod par bgyi/ /rab dkar chu skyes 'dab stong rgyas pa'i rtser/ /rab gsal mtshan mo'i mgon gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /rab dkar kha ba'i mdangs 'phrog mdzes ma'i sku/ /rab tu shel ltar dwangs pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phyag gnyis bai ḍūr pi waṃ sgrengs pa las/ /yid 'phrog glu dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'jig rten che dgu sogs/ /ma lus yid 'phrog mdzad ma khyod༞ /mig sman mdangs bkra thor cog lcang lo la/ /me tog dkar po rin chen do shal spras/ /gser gyi rgyan pa'i rin chen sna brgyan gyis/ /khur tshos mdzes par byas ma khyod༞ /gzhan yang dbu brgyan mgul rgyan la sogs pa/ /rin chen mang po rgyan gyi khra chab be/ /sil khrol snyan par sgrogs pas mdzes par byas/ /bcu drug lo lon lang tsho khyod༞ /g.yon phyogs 'gying zhing spyan gnyis zur gyis gzigs/ /reg na bde bskyed mkhrang ba'i nu mas mdzes/ /chags pa'i nyams ldan dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /me tog dkar po'i chun 'phyang mdzes༞ /spyi gtsug zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan cing / /zhabs gnyis tsog bu'i tshul du legs par bzhugs/ /thugs ni pad dkar 'dab brgyad du gnas pa'i/ /ze 'bru dmar ser mdzes ma khyod༞ /lte ba ljang ser zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /rnam par mi rtog thugs ni hrī yig dkar/ /'dab ma rnams la dbyangs yig zung re ni/ /cung zad ma reg sil zer 'phro phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo'i 'od kyis ma rig mun sel zhing / /ye shes sems dpa' dpag med 'gugs par ldan/ /hrī yig phreng ba 'khor las 'od zer gyis/

/snang srid khyab par mdzad ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'od zer gang des mchog sum nus mthu dang / /snang srid kun gyi mthu bcud ma lus pa/ /legs par bsdus nas nyid thugs 'khor lo la/ /bstim nas blo gros dpag med dang ldan par/ /gyur mdzad nus ldan lha mo khyod༞ /gang gis rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang / /sna tshogs mdzad pa ngo mtshar dpag med rnams/ /sa bcu'i byang sems rnams kyi bskal pa brgyar/ /brjod kyang mi zad gter mnga' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khyod sku bsgom zhing sngags bzlas mchod bstod kyis/ /smon lam dbang gis legs par dgongs nas kyang / /mkhyen brtse nus pa chen po'i rnam rol gyis/ /blu po bdag la 'dod don zhu rnams stsol/ /rnyed dka' 'jig par sla ba'i dal 'byor dang / /me 'obs lta bu'i bzod dka' 'khor ba dang / /sdug bsngal can gyi 'gro rnams pha ma sogs/ /'di rnams gnas tshul rtogs par byin gyis rlob sa/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje byang sems dang / /'khor 'das chos kun rang bzhin dmigs su med/ /de ltar rtogs nas bdag gzhan dngos 'dzin rnams/ /brtson 'grus drag pos 'don par༞ /las nyon thibs bos kun nas bsgribs gyur bas/ /shes byar mi 'bad mi shes mun nag ni/ /sprin rnams nam mkhar dengs nas nyi shar bzhin/ /gyur nas shes rab gsal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang gi 'dod don zhu ba'i ched du bha danta buddha lakṣis sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅgā laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje 'char kun dga' bzang po'i phyi rten bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i mchod rten rnams la gser khebs gsar spos mdzad skabs bsngags brjod// oṃ swa sti/ pad spungs byang chen bkra shis sgo pa'i skor/ /tshad mdo rnam 'grel rnam nges tshad ma'i skor/ /kun las btus dang mdzod gnyis mngon pa'i skor/ /rtsa ba 'jug pa bzhi brgya pa gsum ches zab dbu ma'i skor/

/sde bdun mdo bcas dgongs 'grel rigs gter dang / /sde snod rgyud sde kun 'grel sdom gsum ste/ /pu ti grags chen bco brgyad zhes su grags/ /phar tshad 'dul mngon dbu ma sdom gsum la pod chen drug cu sa skya pa rnams bzhed/ drug po 'di la deng sang 'chad nyan dar/ /ka bcu pa dang ka lnga ka bzhi pa/ /rim bzhin pod grangs bcu dang lnga dang ni/ /pod chen bzhi tsam shes la de ltar grags/ /zhes mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung bzhin dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis brjed tho'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
